selection.ownership: Dovetail Research Pty Ltd, operator of dovetail.com (Australia). The reviewed edition is the public REST API at https://dovetail.com/api, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Dovetail Public API (Bearer personal API tokens, GET /v1/token/info, GET /v1/projects, GET /v1/data, GET /v1/data/{data_id}), Authorization guide, pagination/filter query names, Australian operator identity, and dated incident search (Dovetail Research + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Western Dovetail woodworking hits excluded. No qualifying unresolved Dovetail customer-account compromise identified. Not a breach-free claim.

Official Dovetail Public API at https://dovetail.com/api with Bearer personal API tokens. Token info, projects, and data reads confirmed against pinned source and official OpenAPI on 2026-09-13. Dated incident search found no qualifying unresolved Dovetail Research customer-data compromise. Not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v1/token/info. Returns raw Dovetail JSON under data.
Optional limit binds to page[limit] (0-100). Cursor, sort, and title filters are omitted. Provider next cursors are never followed.
Optional projectId binds to filter[project_id]. Pagination, sort, title, and created_at filters are omitted. Provider next cursors are never followed.
dataId is encoded as the /v1/data/{data_id} path segment. Export endpoints are omitted.
